title: Questions without the typing
text: Writing good questions for every book takes time. Now Shelfie can suggest them. On Manage book, Dad presses Suggest questions.

title: Ideas, ready to pick
text: A short list of ideas for this book appears. Nothing is added until Dad ticks it, and every idea can be reworded first.

title: Tick, reword, add
text: He ticks two, changes the wording of one, and adds them. They join the book's questions, and Nia answers them from her next chapter.

title: If the assistant is away
text: If the assistant is ever unavailable, Dad is told plainly, and he can still write his own questions as before.
